newsitem.title: FINLAND: Raisio sees 97 performance, sales up on 96.
newsitem.headline: Raisio sees 97 performance, sales up on 96.

text.p: Finnish foodstuffs, feeds and chemicals group Raision Tehtaat Oy said on Thursday it expected its 1997 financial performance to improve on 1996.
"The board expects the overall financial performance to improve on 1996," Raisio said in a statement with its January-April results.
"The targeted consolidated turnover for 1997 is five billion markka," it said. In 1996, net sales totalled 3.93 billion markka.
"The international expansion of the Benecol business is being pursued intensively as planned," Raisio said.
"Foodstuff exports have increased at good speed," it said, "and sales to Russia are expected to continue rising."
The financial performance of its Carlshamn Mejeri dairy unit was expected to progress favourably, it said.
The result of the grain division's malting subdivision was expected to improve "to some extent, although the financial year will be rather weak as a whole," Raisio said. @
"The demand and profitability of the chemicals division's binders and special chemicals can be expected to remain at least at the present level," Raisio said.
In January-April, the chemicals division contributed 26.8 million markka to operating profits, versus 21.3 million markka in the year-ago period.

"The animal feeds division is seeking to boost its profitability, especially in pet foods and special feeds," it said. In January-April, the division had an operating profit of 1.4 million markka, up from 0.1 million markka a year ago. @
Raisio said it expected full-year 1997 investments to exceed 400 million markka, after having invested 136 million markka in January-April.
